messages.subject: Ordering boxplots
parts:
Hello All,

Thanks in advance for any help. I am plotting a series of boxplots.
I can order them based upon a factor but I would like plot them in
order of increasing medians. Is there a way within ggplot2 to assign
this order?



My code:

q <- ggplot(known, aes(Comp, scores))

q + geom_boxplot() + coord_flip()

Thanks

--

messages.author: 599a13812d4cd3e8
messages.subject: Re: Ordering boxplots
parts:
The thing I had in mind didn't work :(

I think you are going to have to create new variables, e.g.:

movies$group <- factor(round_any(movies$rating, 0.5))

the for each group calculate the median rating

calc_group_median <- function(rows) {
median <- median(rows$votes)
df <- data.frame(group = rep(rows$group[1],nrow(rows)),
group_median = rep(median,nrow(rows)),
votes = rows$votes)
}

with_medians <- ddply(movies,.(group),calc_group_median)
# there's probably a less ugly way to add the group_median to each row according to group

with_medians$group_median <- factor(with_medians$group_median)

m <- ggplot(with_medians,aes(y = votes, x = group_median, group = group))

That almost works, not sure why the widths of the boxplots are different, though :(

--J
